name: structures
description: Use /structures to manage folder templates, correct project organization, prepare commits, rename assets, and document architecture.

interface.shortDescription: One entrypoint for structure, commits, assets, and documentation
interface.longDescription: Use /structures followed by a task: create a commit title, fix folder structure, rename assets, or document a project. Maintain folder templates in .structures/config.json and load only the requested workflow. Audit folders without edits, apply corrections with reference updates, and export documented website profiles as settings.json. Commit previews stay in chat; commit --push creates a local commit without a remote push. Publish architecture as a Gist only when requested.
defaultPrompt: Use $structures to create a commit title for the current changes.
Use $structures to fix folder structure using .structures/config.json.
Use $structures to rename assets in the selected folder.
Use $structures to document this project and generate a website profile.
